newsitem.title: USA: Texas Util Comanche Peak 2 nuke shut - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Texas Util Comanche Peak 2 nuke shut - NRC.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak 2 nuclear unit in Glen Rose, Texas, tripped off line Friday morning due to the loss of a reactor coolant pump, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said in its Friday report.
A company spokeswoman said the unit tripped off line at 0306 CDT/0406 EDT due to a problem with the service air compressor motor.
A restart date was not yet known, she said. Further details were not yet available.
Texas Utilities' other Comanche Peak unit, also with a generating capacity of 1,150 MW, is currently shut for maintenance and refueling. The unit is expected to return to service in early November.
